rule_description: Transaction amount must be greater than zero
action: Set alert code 1004, message Invalid amount, and go back
evidence: if RCV-AMOUNT = 0 move 1004 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Invalid amount\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE goback end-if

action: Set alert code 9001, message Account file error, and go back
evidence: open i-o ACCOUNT-FILE if WS-ACC-STATUS not = \"00\" move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Account file error\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE goback end-if

action: Set alert code 9002, message Journal file error, close files, and go back
evidence: open i-o JOURNAL-FILE if WS-JRN-STATUS not = \"00\" move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Journal file error\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set alert code 1001, message Account not found, close files, and go back
evidence: when \"23\" move 1001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Account not found\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback

rule_description: Account status validation for blocked, closed, or invalid status
action: Set corresponding alert codes (1002, 1003, or 9001) and messages
evidence: evaluate true when ACC-BLOCKED move 1002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Account blocked\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE when ACC-CLOSED move 1003 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Account closed\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE when not ACC-ACTIVE move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Invalid account status\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE end-evaluate

action: Set alert code 1007, message Insufficient funds, close files, and go back
evidence: if ACC-BALANCE < RCV-AMOUNT move 1007 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Insufficient funds\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set alert code 1005, message Balance overflow, close files, and go back
evidence: if WS-NEW-BALANCE > 999999999999999 move 1005 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Balance overflow\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set alert code 9001, message Account update error, close files, and go back
evidence: if WS-ACC-STATUS not = \"00\" move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Account update error\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

rule_description: Journal write error handling and rollback
action: Set alert code 9002, message Journal write error, perform account rollback, close files, and go back
evidence: if WS-JRN-STATUS not = \"00\" move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Journal write error\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform ROLLBACK-ACCOUNT perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set alert code 1006, message Journal stamp exhausted, and exit stamp generation loop
evidence: when \"00\" if WS-SEQUENCE = 9999 move 1006 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move \"Journal stamp exhausted\" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE exit perform end-if

action: Restore ACC-BALANCE to WS-OLD-BALANCE and rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD
evidence: ROLLBACK-ACCOUNT. if WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED = 1 move RCV-ACCOUNT-NUMBER to ACC-NUMBER read ACCOUNT-FILE key is ACC-NUMBER if WS-ACC-STATUS = \"00\" move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD end-if end-if.

rule_description: Verify transaction amount is not zero
action: Set alert code to 1004, alert message to Invalid amount, and go back
evidence: if RCV-AMOUNT = 0 move 1004 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Invalid amount" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE goback end-if

action: Set alert code to 9001, alert message to Account file error, and go back
evidence: if WS-ACC-STATUS not = "00" move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE goback end-if

action: Set alert code to 9002, alert message to Journal file error, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if WS-JRN-STATUS not = "00" move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Journal file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

condition: WS-ACC-STATUS evaluates to status 23 on account read
action: Set alert code to 1001, alert message to Account not found, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: when "23" move 1001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account not found" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback

condition: WS-ACC-STATUS is neither 00 nor 23 on account read
action: Set alert code to 9001, alert message to Account file error, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: when other move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback

action: Set alert code to 1002 and alert message to Account blocked
evidence: when ACC-BLOCKED move 1002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account blocked" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Set alert code to 1003 and alert message to Account closed
evidence: when ACC-CLOSED move 1003 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account closed" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Set alert code to 9001 and alert message to Invalid account status
evidence: when not ACC-ACTIVE move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Invalid account status" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Set alert code to 1007, alert message to Insufficient funds, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if ACC-BALANCE < RCV-AMOUNT move 1007 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Insufficient funds" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set alert code to 1005, alert message to Balance overflow, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if WS-NEW-BALANCE > 999999999999999 move 1005 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Balance overflow" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set alert code to 9001, alert message to Account update error, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if WS-ACC-STATUS not = "00" move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Account update error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

rule_description: Check journal write status and rollback on failure
action: Set alert code to 9002, alert message to Journal write error, perform ROLLBACK-ACCOUNT, perform CLOSE-FILES, and go back
evidence: if WS-JRN-STATUS not = "00" move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move "Journal write error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE perform ROLLBACK-ACCOUNT perform CLOSE-FILES goback end-if

action: Set WS-STAMP-FOUND to 1
evidence: when 23 move 1 to WS-STAMP-FOUND

rule_description: Increment transaction sequence when journal stamp already exists
condition: WS-JRN-STATUS is equal to 00 and WS-SEQUENCE is not 9999
action: Add 1 to WS-SEQUENCE
evidence: when 00 if WS-SEQUENCE = 9999 ... else add 1 to WS-SEQUENCE end-if

rule_description: Exhaust journal stamp alert when sequence reaches maximum
condition: WS-JRN-STATUS is equal to 00 and WS-SEQUENCE equals 9999
action: Set alert code to 1006, set message to Journal stamp exhausted, and exit perform
evidence: when 00 if WS-SEQUENCE = 9999 move 1006 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move Journal stamp exhausted to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE exit perform end-if

rule_description: Journal file error handling during stamp generation
condition: WS-JRN-STATUS is any other status than 00 or 23
action: Set alert code to 9002, set message to Journal file error, and exit perform
evidence: when other move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE move Journal file error to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE exit perform

rule_description: Rollback account balance to old balance if account was previously updated during an error
condition: WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED = 1 and WS-ACC-STATUS = 00 after reading ACCOUNT-FILE
action: Move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE and rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD
evidence: if WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED = 1 move RCV-ACCOUNT-NUMBER to ACC-NUMBER read ACCOUNT-FILE key is ACC-NUMBER if WS-ACC-STATUS = 00 move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD end-if end-if

rule_description: Close JOURNAL-FILE if it is currently open
action: Close JOURNAL-FILE and set WS-JOURNAL-OPEN to 0
evidence: if WS-JOURNAL-OPEN = 1 close JOURNAL-FILE move 0 to WS-JOURNAL-OPEN end-if

rule_description: Close ACCOUNT-FILE if it is currently open
action: Close ACCOUNT-FILE and set WS-ACCOUNT-OPEN to 0
evidence: if WS-ACCOUNT-OPEN = 1 close ACCOUNT-FILE move 0 to WS-ACCOUNT-OPEN end-if
